scoring_justification: Recomputing thermodynamic properties from DFT raw output is computationally heavy and infeasible in the verifier sandbox; compare reported scalar values to paper-reported gold with relative tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for elastic constants, sound velocities, Debye temperature, heat capacity, Debye temperature at 300 K, and alpha magnitude limits
hidden_assets.generation_method: Elastic constants from Table 1: C11=173.902, C12=44.4884, C44=80.824 GPa. Sound velocities and Debye temp from Table 3: vl=4826.490 m/s, vt=3041.339 m/s, vm=3347.323 m/s, theta_D_el=351.318 K. CV at 1000 K from text: ~124 J/mol/K. Debye temp at 300 K, 0 GPa from text: 294.8 K. Alpha order-of-magnitude from text/figures: roughly 1e-5 K^{-1}.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numbers are the paper's own reported results; alpha gold is replaced by a magnitude range because the paper does not give an exact value.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are compared to the paper’s reported values with tolerances that allow for legitimate implementation differences (functional, code, pseudopotential). Evidence files (E_V_data.json, equilibrium_props.json) are not scored but must exist to demonstrate the workflow was followed.
